easyPrerequisites: Changeling Hero must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
